latest_release.name: PrusaSlicer 2.9.7
latest_release.body:
# ![PrusaSlicer](https://github.com/prusa3d/PrusaSlicer/raw/master/resources/icons/PrusaSlicer_128px.png) 

This is final release of PrusaSlicer 2.9.7. This is a small maintenance release fixing several security vulnerabilities.

## Changes with respect to [2.9.6](https://github.com/prusa3d/PrusaSlicer/releases/tag/version_2.9.6).

- Fixed an out-of-bounds write when loading a 3MF with a negative bed index. 
- Fixed a stack buffer overflow in the `digits()` / `zdigits()` placeholder functions.
- Fixed several issues in the downloader from Printables.
- Fixed couple of potencionally exploitable vulnerabilities in `libbgcode` library when loading malformed binary G-code files.

Special thanks to @5un9hun for participating in our responsible disclosure program.
